faqs.question: What does JSON formatting do?
faqs.answer: JSON formatting (beautifying) adds consistent indentation and line breaks to make compact JSON human-readable. Minifying removes all whitespace to reduce file size.

faqs.question: Is my data sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. All formatting and validation runs entirely in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faqs.question: What CSV delimiters are supported?
faqs.answer: Comma (,), semicolon (;), tab (TSV), and pipe (|). The tool also handles RFC 4180 quoted fields and escaped quotes.
